            overflow-wrap: anywhere;

    <script>
        /* Print / Save as PDF: use light theme while printing, then restore */
        var _wasDark = false;
        window.addEventListener('beforeprint', function () {
            _wasDark = document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark');
            document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');
        });
        window.addEventListener('afterprint', function () {
            if (_wasDark) document.documentElement.classList.add('dark');
        });
        function printResume() {
            try { window.print(); }
            catch (e) { alert('چاپ در این محیط مسدود است. فایل را مستقیم در Chrome یا Edge باز کنید و Ctrl+P بزنید.'); }
        }
    </script>



    <style>
        body {
            font-family: 'Vazirmatn', sans-serif;
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }

        /* Glassmorphism Effect */
        .glass-card {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
            backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
        }
        .dark .glass-card {
            background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.75);
            backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
        }

        /* PCB Grid pattern background */
        .bg-pcb-pattern {
            background-image: radial-gradient(rgba(3, 105, 161, 0.15) 1px, transparent 0);
            background-size: 24px 24px;
        }
        .dark .bg-pcb-pattern {
            background-image: radial-gradient(rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.12) 1px, transparent 0);
            background-size: 24px 24px;
        }

        /* Custom Scrollbar */
        ::-webkit-scrollbar {
            width: 8px;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
            background: rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
            background: #0284c7;
            border-radius: 4px;
        }

        /* Print Styles */
        @media print {
            .no-print {
                display: none !important;
            }
            body {
                background: white !important;
                color: black !important;
            }
            .glass-card {
                background: none !important;
                border: 1px solid #ddd !important;
                box-shadow: none !important;
                backdrop-filter: none !important;
            }
            .print-break-inside-avoid {
                break-inside: avoid;
            }
            .shadow-xl, .shadow-lg, .shadow-md {
                box-shadow: none !important;
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>

    <!-- JavaScript Interactions -->
    <script>
        // Dark Mode Toggle
        function toggleTheme() {
            if (document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark')) {
                document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');
                localStorage.setItem('theme', 'light');
            } else {
                document.documentElement.classList.add('dark');
                localStorage.setItem('theme', 'dark');
            }
        }

        // Initialize Theme preference
        if (localStorage.getItem('theme') === 'dark' || (!('theme' in localStorage) && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches)) {
            document.documentElement.classList.add('dark');
        } else {
            document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');
        }

        // Clipboard Copy Functionality
        function copyToClipboard(text, label) {
            // Using standard execCommand fallback for iframe support
            const el = document.createElement('textarea');
            el.value = text;
            document.body.appendChild(el);
            el.select();
            document.execCommand('copy');
            document.body.removeChild(el);

            showToast(label + ' با موفقیت کپی شد!');
        }

        // Toast Notification System
        function showToast(message) {
            const toast = document.getElementById('toast');
            const toastMessage = document.getElementById('toastMessage');
            
            toastMessage.textContent = message;
            toast.classList.remove('translate-y-24', 'opacity-0');
            toast.classList.add('translate-y-0', 'opacity-100');

            setTimeout(() => {
                toast.classList.remove('translate-y-0', 'opacity-100');
                toast.classList.add('translate-y-24', 'opacity-0');
            }, 3000);
        }
    </script>
